say:1:1610929701:0.text: Right. A meteor shower is the absolute best time for star-chart divination. The readings are supposedly far more accurate than on a normal night.
say:1:1610929701:0.source_cn: ……没错，流星雨出现的时候是做星盘占卜的最佳时机，据说...

say:2:1610929702:0.text: Ugh, I wanted to try a reading during the <style="highlight">Astra Throne</style> meteor shower, but that's not for <style="highlight">another year</style>! I can't wait that long.

say:3:1610929703:0.text: Speaking of meteor showers, remember the very first spell we learned here?
say:3:1610929703:0.source_cn: 说起流星雨，你们还记得入学的时候我们学习的第一个魔法吗？

say:4:1610929704:1.text: Of course, <style="highlight">Starshower</style>! Pretty, but not very practical.

say:5:1610929705:1.text: Well, it makes a lovely backdrop for a marriage proposal...
say:5:1610929705:1.source_cn: 至少可以在求婚的时候用来做背景幕布……
